tool.name: courtlistener_case_search
tool.title: CourtListener Opinions and Federal Docket Search
tool.description:
Search published judicial opinions or federal RECAP dockets through CourtListener. Returns case names, courts, dates, citations, judges, parties, filings, snippets, and canonical record links where available.

Behavioral Transparency:
- Execution: Network call executed synchronously in the cloud via Apify Actor 'captainhandsome/courtlistener-case-search'.
- Side Effects: Strictly read-only; queries public CourtListener and RECAP search data.
- Authentication: Requires APIFY_TOKEN; the Actor supplies its CourtListener integration credential.
- Latency & Limits: Typical runs take 10-45 seconds; timeout capped at 120 seconds.

Usage Guidelines:
- When to use: Use for legal research, litigation monitoring, company case discovery, opinion search, and federal docket screening.
- When NOT to use: Do not treat results as a complete docket, legal advice, or proof of current case status.
- Named alternatives: Use 'federal_register_search' for agency rules and notices, 'sec_edgar_filings' for SEC disclosures, or 'us_business_entity_search' for company registrations.

query.description: Free text across case names and indexed text.

search_type.description: Search judicial opinions or federal RECAP dockets.

court.description: Optional CourtListener court ID such as cafc, txed, or ca9.

nature_of_suit.description: Optional federal nature-of-suit code; dockets only.

include_court_details.description: Add court jurisdiction, website, and PACER court ID.

verification.note: Production relevance canary returned three Oracle-matching federal docket records.
